children: New Zealand Trade Minister Todd McClay said in an emailed statement that the New Zealand government welcomed the bill's passage today. According to Sina Finance, he said the 93-29 vote "clearly reflects strong parliamentary support for this free trade agreement and its considerable economic benefits." The agreement will take effect after both sides complete their respective domestic approval procedures.

title: New Zealand Parliament Passes India Free Trade Agreement Bill
